entry.summary: MODEL COLLAPSE ASKED AT THE WIDEST ANGLE, AND THEN MEASURED. If the layer through which a population reads the world composes without reading, and its compositions become its sources, what collapses is not a model's distribution but the represented world — the set of distinctions a reader can still reach.
